description: USAGE PACKED-DECIMAL WITH NO SIGN (ISO §2023:13.18.60.4 GR11) — a COBOL-2023 addition: the packed item reserves no trailing sign nibble (storage = ceil(Digits/2) bytes), the value is always zero-or-positive, and SR31 forbids an 'S' picture. NO SIGN is a modifier on Usage.Packed (which exists at every edition) so the gate is recognition-based on the parsed noSignPhrase, not a resolved-usage key.
